Update 1.2 is out now on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S!

New feature: New Game+

NG+ unlocks after you complete the game’s Epilogue and lets you experience the story again while keeping your progress – mainly your character level, skills, and inventory.

NG+ also raises the level cap to 100 and removes zone scaling, letting you explore all regions more freely after completing the prologue, with enemy levels balanced and adjusted to your level. Enemies also receive a general damage multiplier to keep encounters engaging throughout the entire NG+ playthrough.

In NG+, armor, swords, and accessories will have new versions with updated stats while keeping their original names and icons. You can easily recognize these items by their new frames and the NG+ label next to their names (and for NG+ legendary items – a unique red frame).

You can access NG+ from the main menu – after choosing your base save and difficulty option, it will start from the beginning of the game. All the perks and inventory from your original save will become available in the prologue, at the start of the Withering Away quest.

List of changes:

General:

  • Soundtrack available via the Eclipse Edition is now extended with additional songs from the game.
  • Multiple terrain geometry fixes for smoother movement during combat and exploration.

Gameplay:

  • Updated health pools for enemies on levels 17-30.
  • Adjusted how often enemies use their abilities during combat.
